measurement: Native brackets inside ±8 km/s for every input and target. Every team supplies its own continuum-normalized spectrum. Source positive fractional absorption max(0,1−I) is multiplied by a mathematical compact taper flat to |v|5, smoothly zero by7.3. Define it as zero beyond the support; no inferred flux in a masked bin. Disk rotation and LSF convolution use only that compact field. The authentic released integrated spectrum is treated with the identical compact source taper before its resolution degradation; an empirically measured disk spectrum already contains optical blurring and rotation. Every model output and target is measured via the same final compact taper, centroid and normalization. Applying a local source taper before blurring and an observed taper afterward do not commute. No exact stellar or atmospheric deconvolution claimed. A center outside ±2 km/s or area≤0.2 refuses the result without omitting any case.
endpoints: All 8 × 3 durations × 5 roles mandatory. Primary RMSE over recentered |v|≤3 km/s (before centering within |v|≤5), diagnostics |v|≤2,4,6. Report mean over 8 lines per date, per-role worst, same-cell values, no continuum selection or fitted shift. Beat both independent marginals on every date, and separately beat released IAG23 on every date for a stronger claim. Mixed flags with unqualified polarity force descriptive-only status. All raw targets and conditional predictions retained. Source compact fields before convolution must match mean/variance exactly and third moment up to 3Cov under 3e−7 scaled numerical threshold.

The source positive-branch profiles and raw local intensities are retained.
